# Governance and Monitoring

This section sets out how the guideline is kept current and enforced. It covers the tracking of standards and regulatory developments (EU AI Act guidance, ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42, IEEE and ITU-T), the monitoring and auditing of activities against the guideline, and a regular audit cadence. It defines the escalation path for unresolved or serious findings, including an independent advisory or ethics body that reviews responsible AI integration and compliance with EU ethics requirements, and the change management of the guideline and the metadata schema across versions. It also states how lessons learned feed into the next version of the guideline and the next model release. It also defines decision rights at release: who may approve, defer or block the release of a model or dataset, how exceptions are requested and recorded, and how disagreements are escalated. The PROTEUS audit schedule and review bodies are given in Annexes F and L.
